$comment: Built on SIP — Proving Ground MEMORY LANE. Sovereign-core dog-off under a hand-labeled (LLM-judged) relevance set.
substrate: sovereign-core (node): BM25 + MiniLM(transformers.js) + RRF, md-vault L1
groundTruth: hand-labeled relevance set (34 queries), LLM-judged — upgrade over the 2026-06-10 lexical token-overlap judge
gate: winner is hybrid, no regression vs lexical on hit@10 & recall@5, and MRR ranking-lift over lexical; target hit@10 >= 0.70

decision.status: sovereign-core ADOPTED — no OSS runtime needed
decision.recommendation: Default embedSource='summary' (beats 'full' on MRR). Hybrid RRF is the ranking lever (+11% MRR over lexical). Per eval-gated policy, sovereign-core meets the bar, so Letta MemFS / LangGraph are NOT adopted (kept as escalation only).

weakness: hit@10 saturates at 1.0 — the 43-atom live vault is too small to stress recall. MRR is the honest discriminator here. Scale test on the 520-atom SIS corpus recommended to differentiate methods on recall under load.
antiGoodhart: precision@10 is low by construction (~1-2 relevant atoms per query, so max ~0.1-0.2); hit@10 / recall@5 / MRR are the real signals here.
attestation: Built on SIP — Starlight Intelligence Protocol
